instruction: Put the red pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["red_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use first candidate; no need to rank

grasp(candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
